Under the Promotion Agreement between Dova Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Valeant, Valeant has the right, at its own expense, during normal business hours and upon reasonable prior notice, through a certified public accounting firm or other auditor selected by Valeant and reasonably acceptable to Dova and upon execution of a confidentiality agreement reasonably satisfactory to Dova, to inspect and audit Dova's records and books, including records of Net Sales of Dova or any Affiliate, to verify Dova's payment obligations and confirm the accuracy and completeness of such records and all payments, provided that such examination shall not occur more often than once per every twelve months during the Term and once during the one-year period following the end of the Term, shall not cover a previously audited period, and Valeant may conduct additional for-cause audits to address significant problems relating to Dova's payment obligations.

Under the Promotion Agreement between Dova Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Valeant, Dova has the right, at its own expense, during normal business hours and upon reasonable prior notice, through a certified public accounting firm or other auditor selected by Dova and reasonably acceptable to Valeant and upon execution of a confidentiality agreement reasonably satisfactory to Valeant, to inspect and audit Valeant's records and books relating to the Valeant Activities to verify Valeant's compliance with the Agreement, provided that such examination shall not occur more often than once per every twelve months during the Term and once during the one-year period following the end of the Term, shall not cover a previously audited period, and Dova may conduct additional for-cause audits to address significant compliance problems relating to Valeant's obligations or in response to any inquiry, inspection, investigation or other requirements of a Government Authority in the Territory relating to the Valeant Activities.

Under the Amend No. 2 to Manufacturing and Supply Agreement between Fleet and Columbia, Fleet shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Columbia, its Affiliates and their successors and permitted assigns (and their officers, directors, stockholders, partners and employees) from Damages arising from (i) any breach by Fleet or its Affiliates of its representations, warranties, covenants, agreements or obligations under the agreement, including failure to timely deliver Product ordered, failure of the Product to meet the Fleet Warranty and/or Product Specifications, or failure to manufacture or warehouse the Product in accordance with the Product Specifications and Applicable Law (including cGMP); (ii) claims of infringement or misappropriation with respect to the manufacture of the Product, except to the extent such claim relates to the use of the Intellectual Property; and (iii) personal injury or property damage to the extent directly resulting from a failure by Fleet, its Affiliates or subcontractors to manufacture, package, or label the Product in accordance with the Specifications, GMP or Applicable Law.
